parameters.content:
## Before You Activate This Workflow

Search each node for `REPLACE_WITH_` and fill in:

1. **REPLACE_WITH_MONDAY_API_KEY** — Admin → API → Personal API Token
2. **REPLACE_WITH_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN** — Your Slack App → OAuth & Permissions → Bot Token (`xoxb-...`)
3. **REPLACE_WITH_SLACK_USER_IDS_COMMA_SEPARATED** — Slack member IDs to auto-invite (e.g. `U012AB3CD,U045EF6GH`). Get them from Slack → Profile → More → Copy Member ID
4. **REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_ACCESS_TOKEN** — Use a Google Service Account. See: https://cloud.google.com/iam/docs/service-account-overview
5. **REPLACE_WITH_CLIENTS_PARENT_FOLDER_ID** — The Google Drive folder ID where client folders should be created (get from Drive URL)
6. **REPLACE_WITH_SALES_CHANNEL_ID** — Slack channel ID for your Sales team (e.g. `C012AB3CD`)
7. **REPLACE_WITH_AD_USER_ID** — Slack user ID for the Account Director to notify

## Monday Automation Setup
In Monday: Automation Center → Custom Automation → When Invoice Status changes to Done → Send Webhook → paste this n8n webhook URL:
`https://YOUR-N8N-INSTANCE/webhook/monday-onboarding`
